question: In which sport is a shuttlecock used?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A shuttlecock is primarily used in the sport of **Badminton**.
 
• Badminton is a racket sport played using rackets to hit a shuttlecock across a net.
 
• The shuttlecock, also known as a birdie, is a high-drag projectile, with an open conical shape formed by feathers or a synthetic alternative embedded into a rounded cork base.
 
• It is designed to fly differently from balls used in other sports, with its unique aerodynamic properties making it more affected by wind and requiring indoor play or specific outdoor conditions.
 
• Badminton is played as singles (one player per side) or doubles (two players per side) and is known for its fast-paced nature and quick reflexes required.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton** has its origins in ancient civilizations of Europe and Asia, but the modern game developed in British India.
 
• The **International Badminton Federation (IBF)**, now known as the Badminton World Federation (BWF), was established in 1934 to govern the sport globally.
 
• Badminton became an **Olympic sport** in 1992, highlighting its international appeal and competitive nature.
 
• Major tournaments include the **All England Open Badminton Championships, BWF World Championships, and the Thomas & Uber Cup.**
 
• Top countries in the sport often include China, Indonesia, South Korea, Denmark, and Malaysia, known for producing world-class players.
